stem.text: The diagrams show four phospholipid molecules.
Which molecule could contribute most to the fluidity of a cell surface membrane?

A.alt: Phospholipid drawing: circle and square head group with two zig-zag hydrocarbon tails.

B.alt: Phospholipid drawing: circle and square head group with two zig-zag hydrocarbon tails, with a double bond in the lower tail.

C.alt: Phospholipid drawing: circle and square head group with two zig-zag hydrocarbon tails, with a double bond in each tail.

D.alt: Phospholipid drawing: circle and square head group with two zig-zag hydrocarbon tails, with double bonds in each tail.
